title: Ambientika
description: matterbridge-ambientika by Südwind GmbH, the manufacturer of Ambientika

username.title: E-mail address
username.description: The e-mail address of your Ambientika app.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password of your Ambientika app.

pollInterval.title: Reading interval
pollInterval.description: Seconds between two readings of all units (10 to 3600).

operatingModeSelect.title: Operating mode as a selection
operatingModeSelect.description: Adds the operating modes of the unit (Smart, Auto, Night, Away, ...) as a mode selection. Controllers that do not know mode selections ignore it.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the units in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all units will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The units in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no units will be excluded.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin. Only for debugging purposes.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes.
